children: Marwynn Holdings, Inc. reported results for the quarter ended July 31, 2026 (Q1 FY2027), with revenue rising sharply to $1.09M and a narrowed net loss attributable to the parent of $(108.9K); diluted loss per share was $(0.005), improved versus the year‑ago quarter.
Revenue: $1.090M for Q1 2027 (three months ended Jul 31, 2026), up from $41.25K in the year‑ago quarter (2,543.5% YoY).
Net income: Net loss attributable to parent $(108.9K) for Q1 2027 vs. net loss $(2,719.8K) in the year‑ago quarter (improved YoY).
Diluted earnings per share: $(0.005) for Q1 2027 vs. $(0.16) in the year‑ago quarter (loss per share narrowed YoY).
Revenue growth was driven by new e‑waste and food sales, with reported revenues of $1.09M for the quarter, a 2,543% increase versus the prior period.
Shifted food sourcing away from China toward domestic suppliers; added a U.S. food vendor and paused certain China imports in response to tariffs.
Consulting and FuAn distribution expanded: consulting revenue increased to $70K and FuAn was reoriented toward ethnic and mainstream retail channels.
Launched the EcoLoopX e‑waste operation in November 2025 and began recyclable material sales in January 2026; a Sales Director was hired to expand B2B collection networks.
Formed NexaCore in March 2026 to explore AI, data center and HPC opportunities; these activities remain in development.
